{{Top|leg}}
The '''Landing Lights Bar''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], that was located in the city [[Hedrett]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
The bar was located in the city of [[Hedrett]], near to [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility|Hedrett Groundport]]. It was a long, low building, that was made of [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]]. Outside, it had a large parking lot and a pale blue neon sign with the bar's name on. The cantina was the site of a lot of [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and brawls among the patrons were also not uncommon. The bar had patrons from among a wide variety of species and most of them were workers at Hedrett Groundport.

==History==
The bar originally had a band, that played live music. However, a drunken brawl spread onto the bandstand, resulting in their instruments being smashed up. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Arrogha]] was a patron of the bar, and in about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled there, to speak to him.
